selection.objective: Expected discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after remaining development costs, commercial costs, rights payments, sharing and financing.

original_informative_bridge.scope: Exact article and independent human functional bridge; excludes chronic toxicology and clinical supply.
original_informative_bridge.nature: Prior analyst planning judgment, not quotation, full-program budget, feasibility demonstration or approval probability.

preliminary_qualification_only.information_scope: Article and/or functional-model feasibility; not automatically the original useful human-function bridge.

exclusions: Major new model or chemistry platform

routes.informative_output: Whether the actual article and disease-functional system can support an interpretable useful-function question.
routes.value_boundary: Qualification-only scope is distinct; compare information and remaining costs even at unchanged price.

routes.informative_output: Useful exact-P2 function at interpretable exposure in a qualified disease/control background.
routes.value_boundary: The original envelope is conditional, not an executable quote or demonstrated feasibility.

routes.informative_output: Whether a credible first result generalizes sufficiently for the intended product claim.
routes.value_boundary: Additional cost and a separate release decision; a first result is not an all-CMT2A claim.

routes.informative_output: A lawful, usable contribution with adequate data/regulatory/supply/development rights and acceptable remaining economics.
routes.value_boundary: Scientific information, ownership, regulatory use/reference and commercial rights are distinct.

routes.informative_output: Preserve capital when available actions are uninformative or unattractive after remaining costs.
routes.value_boundary: Source closure does not demote biology or justify another repetitive desktop pass.

branches.observation: Article, exposure or disease-functional model unqualified
branches.decision: Compare a finite qualification scope or defer; no drug/target-negative inference from inadequate material or model.

branches.observation: Credible useful exact-P2 positive in one qualified background
branches.decision: Consider independent confirmation and relevant exposure/safety follow-up; preserve narrow genotype/claim.

branches.observation: Only organelle morphology or motility improves
branches.decision: Retain mechanism information; the original functional bridge remains unanswered and any next mechanistic tranche needs its own value case.

branches.observation: Only mixture or related article works
branches.decision: Do not credit P2; another article requires a separately defined marginal decision.

branches.observation: No useful exact-P2 function in an interpretable comparison
branches.decision: Scope the negative to article/exposure/model/precision. Strong target-reversal rejection additionally needs post-deficit modifiability evidence.

branches.observation: Genotype-limited, direct-muscle, symptomatic or exposure-dependent benefit
branches.decision: Narrow the useful claim; distinguish direct muscle from axonal regeneration and useful ongoing control from permanent cure. Reject trivial/toxic nonspecific excitation.

branches.observation: Relevant functional injury or unattractive product/rights economics
branches.decision: Stop the adequately tested article/claim or financial route; any successor or science-only purpose requires a separate comparison. Waiting remains available.

completion.completed_information_sprint: Bounded existing exact 8015-P2/MFN2-CMT2A article/exposure, human-model/allele and product/capture review.
reopen_for: Substantive exact-P2 human functional or relevant exposure/safety data that change the intended claim or feasibility.
Specific missing primary data that resolve a decision-changing unit, regimen, causal or model-interpretability issue.
Demonstrably relevant qualified functional model or a concrete current rights, supply, access or scoped-cost fact likely to change the next commitment.
